ev.q: Overall, 5.4% of women reported any type of IPV during pregnancy
Multivariable logistic regression was used to calculate adjusted prevalence ratios and 95% CIs
Weighted prevalence was estimated for each IPV type.
The prevalence of having a preterm birth was higher among women who reported physical, sexual, or any IPV type
Adjusted for respondent age, race and ethnicity, education, health insurance at delivery, and number of previous live births.
Participants are surveyed by mail or telephone 2–6 months postpartum
to conduct jurisdiction-specific, population-based surveillance on experiences before, during, and after pregnancy

methods_quotes.q: Multivariable logistic regression was used to calculate adjusted prevalence ratios and 95% CIs
Statistical significance was determined by whether CIs overlapped the null of 1.0.
Analyses were conducted using SAS-callable SUDAAN (version 11.0.4; RTI International) to account for complex survey design.
PRAMS data are weighted annually by jurisdiction to adjust for sample design, nonresponse, and noncoverage.
